# Retail CoD United Offensive 1.51b dedicated server log lines under the --save-turret client of
# mp_carentan-dm-turret-spawn-uo.txt beside this file. Captured 2026-10-20.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype probe_turret, probe_teleport 1, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, a homepath holding no pak.
# Client 0 is a --probe-team axis net-probe standing as the target, client 1
# the --save-turret --capture-tag spawn-uo gunner (allies).
#
# Three shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_VERSION=uo COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32563 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 \
#       +set probe_spawnlog 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32563 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32563 --save-turret --capture-tag spawn-uo --probe-secs 190
# The axis client started 10 s after the server and the gunner 5 s after it.
#
# PROBE turret <num> <origin> <angles>: a misc_mg42 at the startup census.
# PROBE place <clientNum> <team> <origin> <yaw> <time>: a probe_teleport move,
# made on the first script frame the player reads "playing", at getTime().
# PROBE spawned <clientNum> <time> and PROBE spawnat <clientNum> <origin> <angles>
# (probe_spawnlog 1): the spawn's notify time and where the stock spawn put him.
# J; Q; D; K; are the engine's and the stock dm script's own.
# Lines are copied from games_mp.log with the engine's m:ss stamp, leading
# padding trimmed; every line past InitGame is here.
